sources.coverage: 2020 full-year historical materials page (includes unscheduled/emergency action records)

csv_schema: meeting_start_date,announcement_date,scheduled -- announcement_date (final day of the meeting, when the post-meeting statement is released) is the date used for the S3(b) pre-FOMC 24h tilt window; only rows with scheduled=TRUE are present (no scheduled=FALSE rows are included -- unscheduled/emergency meetings were excluded at compilation time rather than included-then-filtered, since the source pages label them distinctly)
notes_on_counts: 2020 has 7 regularly-scheduled meetings instead of the usual 8: the regularly-scheduled March 17-18, 2020 meeting was CANCELLED per the Fed's own 2020 historical page and superseded by two unscheduled emergency actions on 2020-03-02 and 2020-03-15. Both emergency actions are excluded from this dataset.
2019 had one additional unscheduled intermeeting conference call on 2019-10-04 (repo-market related), separate from the 8 regular meetings; it is excluded from this dataset (not counted in the 8).

2025 has a 'notation vote' entry on 2025-08-22 shown on the Fed's calendar page (Jackson Hole timing / longer-run-goals statement context); this is NOT a standard 2-day policy meeting with a rate decision and was excluded as out-of-cadence, consistent with how the 2020 notation votes (March 19/23/31, August 27) were also excluded.

2026 shows only 4 meetings because the requested window truncates at 2026-07-04: Jan 27-28, Mar 17-18, Apr 28-29, and Jun 16-17 all fall on/before the cutoff; the next scheduled meeting (Jul 28-29, 2026) falls after 2026-07-04 and is correctly excluded.

validation_spot_checks.result: PASS -- confirmed excluded. Fed's own 2020 historical page labels 2020-03-02 and 2020-03-15 explicitly as '(unscheduled) Meeting', distinct from the regularly-scheduled calendar. Neither appears in fomc_dates.csv.

validation_spot_checks.result: PASS -- Fed's own page lists March 17-18, 2020 as '(cancelled)'. Not present in fomc_dates.csv; 2020 correctly has only 7 rows instead of 8.

validation_spot_checks.result: PASS -- present in fomc_dates.csv as meeting_start_date=2018-12-18, announcement_date=2018-12-19.

Regularly-scheduled meeting held immediately after the March 2023 SVB collapse (widely publicized)

Unscheduled intermeeting conference call (repo-market stress response) should be EXCLUDED
validation_spot_checks.result: PASS -- confirmed excluded. Fed's 2019 historical page labels this as an 'unscheduled conference call', distinct from the 8 regular meetings. Not present in fomc_dates.csv; 2019 correctly has 8 rows (the 8 regular meetings only).

emergency_meeting_exclusion_detail: Only regularly-scheduled FOMC meetings (identified as such on the Federal Reserve's own official calendar/historical pages) are included in data/fomc/fomc_dates.csv. All unscheduled/emergency/intermeeting actions identified during acquisition (2020-03-02 unscheduled meeting, 2020-03-15 unscheduled meeting, 2019-10-04 unscheduled conference call) were excluded by construction, not merely flagged. The cancelled 2020-03-17/18 regularly-scheduled meeting is also correctly absent since it was never held.
contingency_note: Acquisition succeeded and was reliably parsed from federalreserve.gov's own calendar and historical pages; no fabrication or approximation was required. S3(b) pre-FOMC tilt proceeds using this dataset.
